summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 27, 2026, presenting its 1H26 earnings results. The filing highlights solid execution with service revenue up 6.1% YoY, EBITDA-AL up 7.8% YoY, and operating cash flow up 11.7% YoY. Key growth engines include mobile and fixed broadband (Ultrafibra +100k net adds) and B2B/Agribusiness IoT. The company notes a new partnership with CNH and the launch of TIM + PicPay for financial services. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine quarterly business update by a foreign private issuer.
